headline: RED / Broad Decline — 3rd Consecutive Red Session
marketPulseNote: NEPSE closed red on June 8, 2026 at 2735.14, down 20.27 points (-0.73%) — the largest single-day drop of the 3-session decline series. Market breadth was extremely negative: 43 advances vs 222 declines and 6 unchanged (5:1 ratio), the worst breadth of the tracked series. Total turnover was Rs.4.08B with 9,236,677 shares traded across 56,845 transactions in 356 scrips. Broker 58 (Naasa Securities) was a NET BUYER with total purchases of NPR 290,751,860 vs sales of NPR 261,820,319 — net inflow of +Rs.28.93M, significantly lower conviction than June 5 (+Rs.131.78M). Key conviction buys: LBBL (49.94%), CREST (52.66%), NHPC (14.57%), AKJCL (8.35%), SOHL (16.66%). Finance (+0.26%) was the ONLY sub-index in the green. AKJCL was net sold by B58 for the first time after 2 sessions of accumulation. CITY continued 4th consecutive session of B58 activity but with reduced conviction (net sell today). RIDI continued distribution (6th session). HDL appeared as new B58 sell at 29.23%.

keyInsights.title: NEPSE Worst Single-Day Drop of Series — 222 Declines vs 43 Advances
keyInsights.body: NEPSE fell -0.73% to 2735.14, the largest single-session drop in the 3-session decline series (June 4: -0.48%, June 5: -0.41%, June 8: -0.73%). Market breadth was catastrophic: 222 declines vs only 43 advances — a 5:1 ratio, the worst of the tracked series. Only Finance (+0.26%) was green. Trading Index (-1.77%), Others (-1.49%), Non Life Insurance (-0.83%), Hotels (-0.71%), and HydroPower (-0.95%) led losses. Cumulative 3-session loss: -31.64 points from 2766.78.

keyInsights.title: B58 Net Buyer but Conviction Dropping — +Rs.28.93M vs +Rs.131.78M Prior
keyInsights.body: B58 net buying has declined sharply: June 4 +Rs.5.15M, June 5 +Rs.131.78M, June 8 +Rs.28.93M. The primary driver was a new position in LBBL (63,022 kitta at 49.94%) and continued NHPC buying (47,125 kitta). However, B58 flipped to net seller in AKJCL (after 2 sessions of accumulation) and CITY (after 3 sessions), suggesting profit-taking or re-evaluation as the market drops further.

keyInsights.title: LBBL — New B58 Conviction Buy at 49.94%
keyInsights.body: Laxmi Sunrise Bank Limited (LBBL) appeared for the first time on the B58 buy list with a massive 63,022 kitta purchase at avg Rs.485.41 (49.94% of total LBBL turnover). This is the largest kitta count of any B58 buy today. No sell recorded — pure accumulation. LBBL is a development bank that B58 appears to be aggressively positioning in. Worth tracking closely.

keyInsights.title: AKJCL — B58 First Net Sell After 2 Sessions of Massive Accumulation
keyInsights.body: After buying 95,963 kitta (June 4 net -13,624), then 304,504 kitta (June 5 net +254,523), B58 sold 70,711 kitta of AKJCL today at 20.63% market share vs only 28,613 bought — net -42,098 kitta. This could be profit-taking after the 2-session accumulation, or a reversal signal. AKJCL dropped from LTP 413 to 404.80. Watch carefully for direction in the next session.

keyInsights.title: CITY — B58 Flow Reversal After 3 Accumulation Sessions
keyInsights.body: CITY was net sold by B58 today (13,033 bought vs 19,048 sold, net -6,015 kitta) after 3 consecutive sessions of accumulation (net +101,340 and +105,821). However, CITY closed +0.47% at 403.90 — showing price resilience. RSI 49.45 is right at the neutral line. The 52-week high of Rs.649 shows how far CITY has come down. The B58 reversal reduces conviction but price action hasn't confirmed a sell.

keyInsights.title: NHPC — 3rd Consecutive B58 Accumulation Session
keyInsights.body: B58 continued accumulating NHPC for the 3rd straight session: 47,125 kitta bought vs 19,385 sold — net +27,740 kitta. Across 3 sessions the net B58 position in NHPC is approximately: +5,659 (Jun 4) + 52,032 (Jun 5) + 27,740 (Jun 8) = ~85,431 net kitta. Despite weak technicals (RSI 43.46, ADX 9.25), B58 is clearly building a position. Entry at current levels remains viable with a tight stop.

keyInsights.title: BUNGAL — Strongest Technical Setup Maintained Despite -2.01% Drop
keyInsights.body: BUNGAL fell -2.01% to 686.00 but retains the strongest technical profile: RSI 51.20 (above 50), ADX 42.36 (strong confirmed trend), AccDist +637.927K (bullish accumulation), MACD signal 28.76 well positive. Aroon Up 57.14% with Aroon Down 0.00%. No B58 activity today but this remains the highest conviction technical buy in the hydro sector.

keyInsights.title: RIDI — 6th Consecutive Session B58 Distribution
keyInsights.body: B58 has now sold RIDI in 6 straight sessions. Today: 25,398 kitta at 10.66% market share (lighter than recent sessions but still consistent direction). The cumulative exit is massive. Avoid completely until B58 shows clear reversal with net buying.

keyInsights.title: BFC — Finance Sector Outperformer with RSI 78.98 — Near Overbought
keyInsights.body: BFC (Best Finance Company) was the standout within the only green sector (Finance +0.26%), closing +2.39% at 526.30. RSI 78.98 is extremely overbought territory. Aroon Up 100%, MACD 10.06 strongly bullish. However with RSI this high, entering now carries significant mean-reversion risk. Watch for RSI pullback to 60-65 range.

keyInsights.title: HFIN — 3rd Consecutive Session B58 Distribution + Strong Downtrend
keyInsights.body: HFIN (Hotel Forest Inn) closed -3.05% at 859.00. RSI 39.93 approaching oversold. ADX 31.96 confirms strong downtrend, Aroon Down 100%, MACD -30.38 deeply negative. AccDist -254.782K. B58 sold 6,605 kitta at 12.26% for 3rd session running. The stock was top transactions (1,423 txns) — retail is accumulating while B58 distributes. Pattern mirrors what happened with RIDI. Avoid.

keyInsights.title: SRLI — Significant Technical Upgrade From Prior Sessions
keyInsights.body: SRLI closed at 400.00 (-2.44%) but the technicals show notable improvement: RSI upgraded to 53.55 (from 56.19→64.87→53.55 trajectory — now with MACD turning clearly positive at 2.16/1.63), Aroon Up 92.86%, and crucially the AD Oscillator has flipped to BULLISH (+214K). This is a genuine upgrade from prior sessions' bearish AD. SRLI now shows the best life insurance technical profile.

keyInsights.title: HDL — New B58 Sell at 29.23% — Watch Previously Tracked Bullish Setup
keyInsights.body: HDL appeared on the B58 sell list for the first time at 29.23% market share (8,481 kitta, avg Rs.1220.26). This conflicts with the prior sessions' bullish technical signal (ADX 42.57, Aroon Up 100%). RSI 49.73 is right at the neutral boundary. The B58 exit is a red flag — downgrade from MONITOR to WATCH/CAUTION and do not enter until B58 re-accumulates.

keyInsights.title: CREST — Top Gainer +13.11% + B58 Both Buying and Selling
keyInsights.body: CREST was today's 2nd top gainer (+13.11%, LTP 1419) while simultaneously being B58's 2nd largest buy (52.66% share, Rs.11.93M) AND 3rd largest sell (44.70% share, Rs.10.13M). This push-pull pattern — B58 buying and selling the same stock at near-equal levels on the same day — suggests institutional arbitrage or position rebalancing rather than directional conviction. Watch for next session clarity.

keyInsights.title: Sector Analysis — Only Finance Green, Trading Index Worst at -1.77%
keyInsights.body: Finance was the sole green sector (+0.26%, 2557.12) for the 3rd time in the tracked series. Trading Index was the worst performer at -1.77% (3474.76). The consistent Finance outperformance in a declining market suggests rotation — investors selling other sectors and parking in finance. Development Bank (-0.98%) and HydroPower (-0.95%) were the next worst after Trading and Others (-1.49%).
